system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: On session start, `MEMORY.md` content is injected into agent's system prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Memory and BM25 RAG sessions injected into systemPrompt; prompts/index.ts not opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Top-2 relevant sessions (1000 chars each) formatted and injected into systemPrompt
env_context_strategy.note: BM25 retrieval over past sessions plus agent tools (read, bash, grep, find); retrieval is over session history, not repo.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: | Micro Compact | 70% | Too many tool results | Prune old tool outputs, keep key info |
context_compaction.note: Context Collapse summarises middle dialogue at 75%; pi-coding-agent auto compact at 83.5%.

observation_format.note: Image content supported by framework structure but no shipped image tool evidenced.

tool_call_format.note: Parser lives in pi-coding-agent dependency, not in evidence; README events mention tool_call_start only.

tool_count.note: Tool list at tools/index.ts and session-service.ts not in evidence; built-ins read/write/bash/edit/grep/find/ls plus lua_exec and ~13 subagent tools mentioned in docs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: 事件驱动**: 响应框架生命周期事件
loop_primitives.note: Agent loop: call model, parse tool calls, execute, return results (architecture-overview). Self-verification correction loop could count as generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.note: Task objects with status via TaskUpdate; primarily for subagent queue.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: | `Agent` | Start a subagent to perform a task |
multi_agent_topology.note: Subagent tools listed as available to agent; default enablement not verified in code.

human_in_loop.note: Docs mention a `before_agent_confirm` extension but no confirmation policy code in evidence; user stop exists.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Stateful AI assistant with multi-turn dialogue, tool execution, and skill invocation
short_term_state.note: Goal-constraint extracted goal and task objects kept beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: At 50% token usage, LLM generates a summary of recent messages → appends to `MEMORY.md`
long_term_memory.note: Skills from skills/ (7 SKILL.md); BM25 retrieval over past sessions acts as episodic store.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Verification**: LLM checks if response aligns with original task/goal
self_verification.note: Separate LLM call in self-verification service; may be same model (self_critique).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: **Retry**: Up to 5 retries before accepting potentially drifted response
retry_policy.note: Retries are correction injections on verification failure; 429 transport retries (3) excluded.

rollback.note: Tool definitions not in evidence; memory 'Rollback' refers to consolidations, not file changes. worktree.ts exists but unopened.

termination_condition.note: Run also ends on SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS (timeout); no step cap evidenced.

cost_controls.note: No config surface for budget/caching in evidence; model switch is manual env var, not routing.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: **读命令** → 透传到原 bash（无限制）
execution_isolation.note: Write commands in WASM (wasmtime) sandbox when enabled via createRuntime(..., true); reads on host bash.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Sandbox restricts file system access to `cwd` via `--dir` flag
filesystem_access.note: Writes scoped to cwd; reads unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: | 恶意写操作 | ✅ 白名单命令 |

tracing.note: Session files plus event stream; lib/logger.ts also present.
